metadata.title: Renormalized volume, Generalized Loewner energy, and Grunsky determinant of multiply connected domains
metadata.abstract: We define and study three Möbius invariant functionals for multiply connected planar domains with finitely many boundary components: the Loewner energy, the renormalized volume, and the Grunsky determinant. Using quasiconformal variations, we prove that when the boundary curves are sufficiently regular, the three functionals differ only by a modulus-dependent constant. We also prove that the Loewner energy is finite if and only if every boundary curve is a Weil--Petersson quasicircle. Moreover, we prove that the three functionals all attain their unique extremal value at the circle domains. In particular, the Loewner energy is zero if and only if it is evaluated at a circle domain. Finally, we use the minimization of Loewner energy to give a new proof of the finitely connected version of Koebe uniformization theorem.
